# Source: https://www.juniper.net/documentation/en_US/junos12.3/topics/example/junos-cli-statements-and-identifiers-activating-deactivating.html
# Page title: Examples: Deactivating and Reactivating Statements and Identifiers in a Junos Configuration - Technical Documentation - Support - Juniper Networks
# Source type: documentation
# Documentation set (page metadata): junos12.3 (URL path)
# Junos release shown: not stated
# Retrieved: 2026-10-06
# Assumptions: HIER-1 (hierarchical format)
# Note: 'deactivate at-5/2/0' then 'show': the statement gets the 'inactive:' prefix. The page elides lines with '...' and nests the second session inside the first, as published.
# Note: The page renders the sample as nested <span> blocks with a left margin per level: the text is copied as published, indentation rebuilt as 4 spaces per level.
# ---
[edit interfaces]
user@host# show
at-5/2/0 {
    traceoptions {
        traceflag all;
    }
    atm-options {
        vpi 0 maximum-vcs 256;
    }
    unit 0 {
        ...
        [edit interfaces]
        user@host# deactivate at-5/2/0
        [edit interfaces]
        user@host# show
        inactive: at-5/2/0 {
            traceoptions {
                traceflag all;
            }
            ...
        }
    }
}
